name: Media bin drag
oneLiner: a glass media bin of clip thumbnails cut from the brand's own screens and photos pops in, a cursor grabs one, it lifts and tilts, rides an arc down while it stretches into a clip, squashes into the empty slot on the timeline with the edges snapping and the audio growing under it, then the playhead plays across the new cut
say: when the speaker says they pull a clip from their footage or library into the edit ('I grab the B-roll and drop it in', 'all my clips sit in one folder'): the bin fills while they set it up, the clip drops into the timeline on 'drop' or 'in'
